summary: Palisade adds built-in update downloads, restart controls and signed release notes in Device settings.

items: Check for updates, see download progress, pause automatic updates and choose when to restart.
Browse verified release summaries and details while offline.
Palisade verifies the release signature and both installer checksums before an update can run.
Installed upgrade, UAC cancellation and authenticated session preservation still need verification on a disposable Windows test device.

compatibility: Windows 10 and 11 on x64. Update Manager remains available for manual repair.
